text:
deploy-bot: Rollout complete for inference-service v2024.11.3 -> eu1, apac1. Postdeploy smokewave started (smokewave-id: sw-2649).

alex: saw a p95 spike on the synth heartbeat in eu1, started ~T+2m after rollout. p95 ~210ms vs baseline 110ms :eyes:

maria: can you paste the synth probe output? which probe (embed/kvs/prefix)?

alex: prefix-kv probe. snippet:
```
region: eu1
probe: prefix-kv-synth
p50: 65ms
p95: 210ms
errs: 2/120 (1.6%)
baseline_p95: 110ms
``` 

sam_oncall: checking host metrics now — GPU util steady; io wait ≈ 2-3%. kv cache miss rate ticked up on a subset of hosts, looks like warmup noise.

priya: hmm could be cache warmup + jitter in probe timing. We rolled warmup-window=30s for this release. Worthing to increase to 120s for eu1 while we watch.

noah: suggestion: pin eu1 to v2024.11.2 (previous variant) for customer traffic while we let warmup finish, then retest. that avoids rollback across regions.

maria: +1 to pin. can we do a quick canary pin at routing level? If routing can't, then move eu1 traffic to previous model variant.

alex: I can trigger routing pin for eu1 now. Will also extend smokewave window another 10m to observe trend. If p95 stays >1.8x baseline for next 10m we plan rollback.

deploy-bot: Locking rollout: region=eu1 action=pin model=v2024.11.2 initiated by alex.

sam_oncall: Confirmed pin applied. eu1 traffic now routed to v2024.11.2. Live metrics reverting towards baseline.

priya: made a note to bump warmup-window to 120s in the release config and open a PR to backfill for future rollouts.

maria: thanks. Action items: (1) alex - extend smokewave by 10m & monitor; (2) priya - config PR for warmup; (3) sam_oncall - keep observing infra metrics; (4) noah - prepare rollback steps if pin doesn't help.

noah: LGTM. will standby for rollback checklist.

alex: monitoring — p95 trending down to 115ms after pin :thumbsup: Will post update in 5m.

maria: closing this thread in 30m if stable. if any degradation reopen and ping @sre-oncall.

deploy-bot: smokewave sw-2649 status=pin_applied region=eu1
